This One Pan Chicken & Gravy is an easy and delicious 30 minute dinner!  INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken breasts  Salt, pepper, garlic powder  3 tbsp butter 3 tbsp flour  2 cups chicken broth  1/2 tsp each of salt, pepper, oregano, and thyme  1 tsp each of paprika, onion powder, garlic powder  INSTRUCTIONS  Cut chicken breasts in half lengthwise to make them thinner. Season the chicken with some salt, pepper, and garlic powder (I don’t use exact measurements for this part).  In a skillet over medium high heat melt 3 tbsp of butter. Once the butter has melted add 3 tbsp of flour and stir continuously until well combined. Let cook for a few minutes while still stirring.  Add 2 cups of chicken broth and stir well. Season with salt, pepper, oregano, thyme, paprika, onion powder, and garlic powder. Stir well and when it starts bubbling add the chicken to the skillet.  Make sure the chicken is covered in the gravy, cover with a lid, and turn the heat down to medium low. Let this cook for 12-15 minutes or until the chicken reaches an internal temp of 165 degrees. My chicken was ready in 12 minutes, but they were pretty thin.  Shred the chicken and serve over mashed potatoes! Enjoy! Let me know if you try it out.  #chickenandgravy #easyrecipe #dinner #onepanmeal #chickenrecipes

Creamy Tuscan Chicken 🍗✨ This creamy Tuscan chicken is packed with juicy seasoned chicken, garlic, spinach, and sweet grape tomatoes in a rich Parmesan cream sauce. It’s perfect served over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice! 😋  🍗 Creamy Tuscan Chicken Ingredients:  Chicken seasoning  * 2 to 3 chicken breasts, sliced in half * Salt & pepper * ½ tsp smoked paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tbsp Italian seasoning * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes (optional) Sauce: * 1 tbsp butter * ½ onion, diced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved * 2 cups spinach * 1 cup heavy cream * ¼ cup grated Parmesan * Salt & pepper, to taste * Fresh parsley Directions: Season the chicken with all the spices. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a skillet and cook the chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. In the same skillet, melt the butter and sauté the onion and garlic until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and cook for 2–3 minutes, then stir in the spinach until wilted. Pour in the heavy cream and Parmesan, stirring until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Return the chicken to the skillet and let simmer for 2–3 minutes. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice. Enjoy! 🤍

What’s for dinner tonight? A little taste of sunshine in a pot! 🍋 This Greek lemon chicken and potatoes is an easy weeknight dinner where the oven does all the hard work. Served with a fresh Greek salad, it’s a meal I come back to time and time again. Definitely a family favorite! Prep time: 20 minutes  Bake time: 2 hours  Yields: 7-8 servings  Ingredients: 4 to 5 golden potatoes, peeled and quartered (3 lbs) 7 pieces of chicken (bone-in thighs and drumsticks work beautifully, but use your favorite!) (2 lbs. 10 oz )  You can also use boneless pieces as well, reduce bake time by 30 minutes.  For the sauce: Juice of 2 large lemons about 1/2 cup  1/4 cup good-quality olive oil 1 tbsp Dijon mustard 6 garlic cloves, minced 2 to 3 tsp salt A few sprigs of fresh oregano or 1 tbsp. Dried oregano  1/4 cup water  Dairy free Greek salad:  6 Persian cucumbers  3 beefsteak tomatoes  1 red pepper  1/2 red onion  1 cup pitted Kalamata olives  1 bunch flat head parsley  Dressing:  1/3 cup olive oil  1/4 cup fresh lemon juice  2 tbsp. Red wine vinegar  2 minced garlic cloves  1 tbsp. dried oregano  2 tsp. salt  1 tsp. black pepper  Instructions: Prep the chicken and potatoes:  Peel and rinse your golden potatoes, then cut them into large wedges. Wash and pat dry your chicken pieces. Layer in your pot: Arrange the chicken pieces in a large oven-safe pot or braiser (I use a 14-inch cast iron). Lay the potato wedges on top.  Tip: If your pot has plastic handles, wrap them in foil and you're good to go in the oven. No oven-safe lid? Cover with parchment and foil. Make the sauce: In a jar, combine the olive oil, fresh lemon juice, Dijon mustard, minced garlic, salt, and oregano. Give it a good shake until everything is well mixed and emulsified. Assemble: Pour the sauce evenly over the chicken and potatoes. Add 1/4 cup water to the jar, mix again and pour over.  Bake: Cover and bake in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 1 hour and 30 minutes. Finish uncovered: After 1.5 hours, remove the lid, baste the chicken and potatoes with those delicious juices, and return to the oven uncovered for 30 minutes, until everything is golden and caramelized. While the chicken is baking, prepare the salad. Combine everything in a bowl.  Prepare the dressing in the sane jar as the sauce for the chicken. Mix well and dress salad.  Toss and enjoy ❤️ Every bite is bursting with flavor — fresh, zesty, and comforting. Let the oven do the work, and enjoy a little taste of Greece right at home. #onepanmeal #sivanskitchen #easyrecipe #greekchicken #chickenandpotatoes

Sticky Chicken & Rice!✨🍚#homemadefood #EasyRecipes #cookingathome #budgetrecipes #DinnerIdeas  Recipe:  Chicken: * 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cubed * 1 tsp each onion powder, garlic powder & salt * ½ tsp each black pepper & paprika * 2 tbsp olive oil * ⅓ cup cornstarch * Olive oil for cooking Sticky Sauce: * ½ cup soy sauce * ⅓ cup brown sugar or honey * 1 tbsp hoisin sauce * 1 tbsp ketchup * 1 tsp ginger paste * ½ tbsp minced garlic * 1½ tbsp cornstarch * 2 tbsp butter For serving: White rice, green onions & sesame seeds Instructions 1. Season chicken with onion powder, garlic powder, salt, pepper, paprika and olive oil. Toss with cornstarch until evenly coated. 2. Dinners That Pay My Rent, Episode 1: Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken Pasta 🍗🍝 Crispy skin-on chicken over penne in a creamy garlic parmesan sauce, all in one pan. Ready in about 30 minutes. Ingredients: - 2 bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs - Salt & black pepper, to taste - 1 tsp garlic powder - 1 tsp paprika - 4-5 oz penne pasta (about 2 cups dry) For the sauce: - 1 tbsp unsalted butter - 2 garlic cloves, minced - 1/4 cup chicken broth - 2/3 cup heavy cream - 1/4 cup parmesan, freshly grated, plus more for topping - Squeeze of lemon juice (about 1/4 lemon) - Fresh parsley, chopped - 1/2 cup reserved pasta water Steps: 1. Pat the thighs completely dry and season both sides with the salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika. 2. Put a pot of well-salted water on to boil for the pasta. 3. Heat a skillet over medium heat and place the chicken skin-side down. Cook 6-8 minutes without moving it, until the skin is golden and crispy. 4. Flip and cook another 5-7 minutes until cooked through (165°F / 74°C inside). Remove and set aside to rest. 5. Cook the penne 1 minute less than the package says. Save 1/2 cup of the pasta water before draining. 6. Lower the skillet heat. Add the butter to the same pan, then the garlic — cook just until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Don't let it brown. 7. Pour in the chicken broth and scrape up all the browned bits from the bottom. 8. Add the heavy cream and parmesan. Simmer 3-5 minutes until it thickens. 9. Toss the drained pasta into the sauce and cook together 1-2 minutes, adding splashes of the pasta water until the sauce is glossy and coats every piece. 10. Squeeze the lemon juice over the pasta, then place the chicken on top. 11. Finish with parsley and extra parmesan, and enjoy! #garlic #butter #chicken #pasta #easyrecipe

DUMP & BAKE SMOTHERED CHICKEN DINNER 🍗🤎 The kind of dinner that tastes like you spent all day in the kitchen, but really you just threw everything in a baking dish and let the oven do the work! Tender, juicy chicken smothered in homemade gravy with hardly any effort. Serve it over mashed potatoes or rice with your favorite sides and you’ve got yourself a good home-cooked meal! RECIPE BELOW ⬇️ Ingredients: 2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs Olive oil Salt & pepper Garlic powder Onion powder Paprika Cajun seasoning (optional, for a little kick) 1 sprig fresh rosemary 2 tbsp butter 2 cups chicken broth Carrots or your favorite veggies 2 tbsp cornstarch + 2 tbsp water (use 3 tbsp of each for a thicker gravy) Directions: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Add chicken thighs and carrots to a baking dish. Drizzle with olive oil and season generously with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and Cajun seasoning if using. Don’t be shy with the seasonings! This is where all your flavor comes from, so eyeball it and season heavily. 2. Add rosemary, butter, and chicken broth. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350°F for approximately 50 minutes. 3. Remove from oven and carefully pour just the broth into a separate bowl or measuring cup. 4. Mix 2 tbsp cornstarch with 2 tbsp cold water to make a slurry. If you prefer a thicker gravy, use 3 tbsp cornstarch and 3 tbsp water instead. Stir the slurry into the hot broth until well combined, then pour everything back over the chicken and veggies. 5. Return to the oven uncovered at 400°F for approximately 20 minutes, or until the gravy has thickened and the chicken is tender and fully cooked (165°F internally). Serve over creamy mashed potatoes or rice with green beans, a warm dinner roll, or whatever your heart desires! That’s the beauty of cooking. Make it how YOU like it! 🤎 Save this one for an easy, comforting weeknight dinner! #easymeal #easyrecipe #momlife #fallvibes #smotheredchicken

INGREDIENTS: * 2–3 chicken breasts, cubed * 12 oz pasta * 1 tbsp olive oil @getgraza  *4 tbsp butter * 1½ cups heavy whipping cream (+ a splash more if needed) * 1 cup mozzarella cheese * ½ cup parmesan cheese * ½ cup pepper jack cheese * 1 tbsp Dijon mustard SEASONINGS (ALL TO TASTE): * Kinder’s Cowboy Butter Seasoning @Kinder's Flavors *Garlic powder * Onion powder * Italian seasoning * Paprika * Slap Ya Mama @Slap Ya Mama  * Salt & pepper INSTRUCTIONS: 1. Ingredients: 2 cups white rice 1 (10.5-ounces) can condensed French onion soup 2 (10.5 ounce) cans condensed beef consomme 8 ounces baby portobello mushrooms, roughly chopped 1 cup grated Pecorino Romano or Parmesan cheese, divided 1 stick butter, cut into 8 pieces 2 pounds boneless skinless chicken thighs 1 1/4 teaspoons kosher salt 3/4 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper 1 teaspoon garlic powder 1 teaspoon onion powder 1 teaspoon paprika 1 tablespoon chopped parsley (optional) Directions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Marry Me Chicken 🍅✨ A classic dinner idea made a little lighter and packed with protein! This meal is made in one pan and comes together in about 30 minutes. It's the perfect comfort food meal while also helping you hit your protein goals! Makes 4 servings. 4 small chicken breasts (or 2 large cut in half) 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp Italian seasoning ½ tsp paprika ½ tsp garlic powder Salt and black pepper, to taste 3 cloves garlic, minced ¾ cup low-sodium chicken broth ⅓ cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes, drained 1 cup low-fat cottage cheese ½ cup fat-free milk ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese 2 cups fresh spinach Fresh basil, for garnish 1. Blend the cottage cheese and fat-free milk until completely smooth and creamy. 2. Season the chicken with the Italian seasoning, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the chicken for 4 minutes per side until golden. Transfer to a plate. 4. Reduce the heat to low-medium and cook the garlic for about 30 seconds until fragrant. 5. Pour in the chicken broth, scraping up any browned bits from the pan. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes and simmer for 2-3 minutes. 6. Remove the skillet from the heat and let cool for about five minutes. 7. Slowly whisk the cottage cheese mixture into the skillet until smooth. (Make sure tomato mixture is cool enough before adding the cottage cheese to prevent curdling!) 8. Add the spinach and cook until wilted. Add Parmesan and mix until melted. 9. Return the chicken to the skillet and warm over low heat for 3-4 minutes. Garnish with fresh basil and enjoy! Serve over pasta, rice, vegetables or bread. #marrymechicken #easydinnerideas #onepanmeal

Creamy Chicken in 20 Minutes! Weeknights can get a little hectic, and sometimes you just need something quick and easy for dinner! Nothing beats a good chicken dinner, especially when it looks and tastes like something you’d order at a nice Italian restaurant! The best part is you don’t have to spend hours in the kitchen to make something this good. Pollo alla Valdostana Ingredients 1 lb (450 g) thin chicken cutlets 1/4 lb (115 g) prosciutto cotto (Italian cooked ham) 1/3 lb (150 g) Fontina cheese, shredded 1/2 cup white wine 1/2 cup chicken or vegetable broth (plus an extra 1/2 cup for more sauce) Flour Extra virgin olive oil Knob of butter Salt and pepper Fresh parsley Instructions 1. Heat olive oil and a knob of butter in a pan over medium-high heat. 2. While the butter melts, lightly flour the chicken cutlets and place them directly into the pan. 3. Cook for about 2 minutes per side, seasoning with salt and pepper. 4. Add the white wine and let it reduce for a minute or two. 5. Pour in the broth, then top each cutlet with prosciutto cotto, Fontina cheese, and fresh parsley. 6. Cover and simmer until the chicken is cooked through, the cheese melts, and the sauce thickens. #chicken #easyrecipe #fyp

💥bang bang chicken 🍗 Ingredients  1.5 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs season to your hearts desire  salt and pepper onion powder  garlic powder  smoked paprika  Sauce 1/2 cup Kewpie mayo @Kewpieusa  3 tbsp sweet chili sauce  Sriracha to taste  1/2 tbsp lime juice  Instructions  1. Chicken pot pie with stuffing on top. perfect for when you’re craving an easy thanksgiving dinner on a weeknight. It’s creamy, delicious, and all made in one pot.  Ingredients Chicken: * 1½ lbs chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces * 1 tsp each garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, poultry seasoning & salt * Freshly cracked black pepper * Oil, for cooking Stuffing: * 1 package Kooshy sourdough stuffing mix * 1 medium onion, diced * 3 celery stalks, thinly sliced * 4 garlic cloves, minced * 1 tbsp butter + a little oil * 4 tbsp butter * 2 cups chicken bone broth (or chicken broth) Creamy filling: * 2 tbsp butter * ⅓ cup all-purpose flour * 2 cups chicken bone broth (or chicken broth) * 1 cup heavy cream * 1 cup frozen peas & carrots * 1½ tsp garlic powder * 1 tsp onion powder * 1 tsp poultry seasoning * ½ tsp salt * Freshly cracked black pepper * 5 sprigs fresh thyme, leaves removed Instructions 1. Season chicken with oil and all the chicken seasonings. Cook in a large oven-safe skillet until cooked through, then remove and set aside. 2. In the same skillet, add a little oil and 1 tbsp butter. Sauté onion and celery for 6–8 minutes, then add garlic and cook another 30 seconds. 3. Remove about ⅔ of the veggies and set aside. To the remaining veggies, add 4 tbsp butter and 2 cups broth. Bring to a simmer, transfer to a heat-safe measuring cup, and set aside. 4. In the same skillet, melt 2 tbsp butter and return the reserved veggies. Stir in flour and cook for 1 minute. Gradually add the remaining 2 cups broth and heavy cream, stirring until smooth. Add garlic powder, onion powder, poultry seasoning, salt, pepper, and fresh thyme. Simmer until slightly thickened. 5. Stir in frozen peas and carrots, followed by the cooked chicken. Mix until evenly coated in the creamy sauce. 6. Now prepare the stuffing. Pour the reserved warm buttery broth mixture over the sourdough stuffing mix and gently toss. Allow the bread to absorb the liquid for a few minutes, then evenly spread over the creamy chicken filling without packing it down. 7. Bake uncovered at 375°F for 20-30 minutes, until the stuffing is golden and crispy and the filling is bubbling. Serve with creamy mashed potatoes for the ultimate comfort meal. ##dinneridea##chickenpotpie##stuffing##easydinnerideas##weeknightdinner

After raising 8 kids, this is the dinner they STILL ask for 🍗 Tender teriyaki chicken in a sweet, savory homemade sauce, served over rice. Just dump it in the crock pot and let it simmer all day. 🍚 Ingredients: 🍗 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts 🧅 ½ white onion, chopped 🍯 ¼ cup brown sugar 🥣 ½ cup low sodium soy sauce 🥣 ¼ cup rice wine vinegar 🍯 ¼ cup honey 🧄 2 tsp minced garlic 🌿 ½ tsp ground ginger 🧂 ½ tsp pepper 🍚 Cooked rice, for serving 🌱 2 tbsp sesame seeds, optional 🌱 2 stalks green onions, diced, optional Steps: 1️⃣ Place chicken in the crock pot and top with chopped onion 2️⃣ Whisk together brown sugar, honey, soy sauce, rice wine vinegar, garlic, ginger, and pepper 3️⃣ Pour the sauce over the chicken 4️⃣ Cover and cook on low 6-8 hours or high 3-4 hours, until chicken is cooked through 5️⃣ Remove chicken, shred with two forks, and return to the crock pot 6️⃣ Stir to coat in the sauce 7️⃣ Serve over rice, topped with sesame seeds and green onions! 🙌 💡 Want a thicker sauce? Creamy Roasted Onion & Garlic Chicken Pasta Sweet roasted onions, buttery garlic, and creamy Parmesan sauce. Save this for pasta night! Ingredients: ¾ lb chicken breasts, 8 oz pasta, 1½ large onions (thinly sliced), 1 head garlic, 1½ tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp butter, ¾ tsp kosher salt, ½ tsp pepper, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, ½ tsp smoked paprika, ⅛ tsp red pepper flakes (optional), ½ cup heavy cream, ½ cup grated Parmesan, 2 tbsp chopped parsley, and ¾ cup reserved pasta water. Directions: 1. Heat oven to 400°F. Toss onions with 1 tbsp oil, butter, half the salt and pepper, and ½ tsp Italian seasoning in an 8x8 baking dish. Slice the top off garlic, drizzle with ½ tsp oil, wrap in foil, and place in dish. Roast 35–40 minutes, stirring occasionally, until golden. 2. Pound chicken to ¾-inch thickness. Coat with 1 tsp oil, remaining salt, pepper, Italian seasoning, paprika, and pepper flakes. Place over onions; bake 20–25 minutes, until chicken reaches 165°F. Rest 5 minutes, then slice. 3. Cook pasta until al dente; reserve ¾ cup pasta water. 4. Squeeze softened garlic into onions and mash. Stir in cream and ¼ cup pasta water; bake 5 minutes. Remove and let bubbling settle, then stir in Parmesan. Toss with chicken, pasta, and parsley, adding more pasta water as needed. Happy cooking! #pastalovers #easyrecipes #dinnerideasُ #comfortfood

🍗🌶️ Cajun Chicken Rigatoni Spicy Cajun chicken with rich, creamy rigatoni in a silky sauce. Bold, cozy, and so easy! INGREDIENTS: - 1 1/2 lbs boneless chicken breasts, sliced - 2 tbsp Cajun seasoning - 12 oz rigatoni pasta - 2 tbsp olive oil - 3 garlic cloves, minced - 1 small onion, finely chopped - 1 cup heavy cream - 1/2 cup chicken broth - 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese - 1 can (14 oz) diced tomatoes, drained - 1 tsp smoked paprika - Salt and black pepper to taste - Fresh parsley, chopped, for garnish INSTRUCTIONS: 1. Season the chicken slices with Cajun seasoning, salt and pepper. 2. Cook the rigatoni in salted water until al dente, then drain, reserving 1/2 cup pasta water. 3. Sear the chicken in olive oil over medium-high heat for 3-4 minutes per side until golden, then set aside. 4. In the same pan, soften the onion and garlic for 2 minutes. 5. Pour in the cream and chicken broth, add the tomatoes and parmesan, and simmer for 5 minutes until slightly thick. 6. Toss in the rigatoni with a splash of pasta water until coated. 7. Slice the chicken, arrange it on top, garnish with parsley, and serve. Prep 15 | Cook 25 | Servings 4 #CajunChicken #ChickenRigatoni #CreamyPasta #EasyDinner #PastaRecipes

CROCKPOT CHICKEN POT PIE 🥧🤎 The easiest comfort meal for those nights when you want a homemade dinner without spending hours in the kitchen! WHAT YOU’LL NEED: * 3 boneless, skinless chicken breasts * 2 (10.5 oz) cans cream of chicken soup * 1 (10.5 oz) can cream of celery soup * A splash of chicken broth * 1 (12 oz) bag frozen mixed vegetables * Salt + pepper, Garlic powder & paprika, to taste * 1 can refrigerated biscuits HOW TO MAKE IT: 1. Add your chicken breasts to the bottom of your crockpot. 2. Season the chicken with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika. 3. Pour in the cream of chicken, cream of celery, and a splash of chicken broth. 4. Add your frozen veggies and give everything a good stir to combine. 5. Cover and let your crockpot do the work! Cook on LOW for 6–8 hours or HIGH for 4–6 hours, until the chicken reaches 165°F. 6. About 30 minutes before serving, shred the chicken and stir everything together until it’s creamy and combined. 7. Bake your biscuits separately according to the package directions until they’re golden brown. 8. Scoop that creamy chicken pot pie filling into bowls, top with a warm, buttery biscuit, and ENJOY! 🤎 Cozy, creamy, and SO easy. The kind of dinner everyone goes back for seconds of! #CrockpotRecipes #SlowCookerMeals #ChickenPotPie #EasyDinnerIdeas #FamilyDinnerIdeas

One pot chicken & rice — ready in 30 minutes 👌  One pot, barely any dishes, and the whole family actually ate it. This is the weeknight dinner I make on repeat. You need: Chicken thighs or bone in chicken, whatever you prefer, about 2 lbs 1 onion, diced 1 cup sliced cremini mushrooms 1 1/2 cups basmati rice, rinsed About 2 1/2 cups chicken broth Olive oil For the marinade: 2 tbsp olive oil 2 tsp paprika 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tbsp Trader Joe’s Green Goddess seasoning 2 tsp Montreal chicken spice 1 tsp oregano Salt and pepper Mix the marinade and coat the chicken. Heat olive oil in a big pot and brown the chicken on both sides. Take it out. Pour a splash of broth in and scrape up all the brown bits. Add the onion and mushrooms and cook a few minutes. Add the rice and stir it around. Put the chicken back on top and pour in the rest of the broth. Cover and cook on low for 25 minutes. Save this for the nights you have no idea what to make. videos.caption: Creamy Chicken in 20 Minutes! Weeknights can get a little hectic, and sometimes you just need something quick and easy for dinner! Nothing beats a good chicken dinner, especially when it looks and tastes like something you’d order at a nice Italian restaurant! The best part is you don’t have to spend hours in the kitchen to make something this good. Pollo alla Valdostana Ingredients 1 lb (450 g) thin chicken cutlets 1/4 lb (115 g) prosciutto cotto (Italian cooked ham) 1/3 lb (150 g) Fontina cheese, shredded 1/2 cup white wine 1/2 cup chicken or vegetable broth (plus an extra 1/2 cup for more sauce) Flour Extra virgin olive oil Knob of butter Salt and pepper Fresh parsley Instructions 1. Heat olive oil and a knob of butter in a pan over medium-high heat. 2. While the butter melts, lightly flour the chicken cutlets and place them directly into the pan. 3. Cook for about 2 minutes per side, seasoning with salt and pepper. 4. Add the white wine and let it reduce for a minute or two. 5. Pour in the broth, then top each cutlet with prosciutto cotto, Fontina cheese, and fresh parsley. 6. Cover and simmer until the chicken is cooked through, the cheese melts, and the sauce thickens. #chicken #easyrecipe #fyp

Nobody likes a DRY Chicken Alfredo! 😂🔥 Check comments for recipe! Listen, I don't care how creamy your Alfredo is before it goes into the oven. If you don't give that pasta a little extra moisture, you might be disappointed when it's time to reheat those leftovers! I made this extra-cheesy Chicken Alfredo Rigatoni Bake for my 17-year-old football-playing nephew, and he loved it so much he packed it for lunch THREE days in a row! Baby, we're talking tender chicken thighs, sautéed peppers and onions, homemade Alfredo sauce, and layers of extra-sharp cheddar, mozzarella, and sharp white cheddar! My secret? Reserve a little heavy cream or milk and drizzle it over the pasta before baking. THIS IS A MUST FOR ALL BAKED PASTAS!! It helps keep everything rich, silky, and creamy!
